fact: SIPAO was officially transferred from INTERPOL to the national and regional West African authorities at a ceremony in Abuja on 8 April 2025 as the EU-funded FED 3 project ended, and the sustainability workshop in Abidjan on 1 April 2025 cited Togo among the countries showing a solid path to sustaining the system; the newsletter gives no figure for Togolese units entering cases.
title: Lettre d’information SIPAO, numéro 27
